policy: Armenia releases are public because the v1 donor artifact and target sources are public. Every per-record artifact must retain an explicit US-donor/support-stratum banner and must never be described as Armenian microdata. Releases use data_build_id plus Hugging Face revision, never ordinal versions.

licence.name: ArmStat ILCS open dissemination (exact licence text to verify)
licence.notes: ArmStat makes ILCS household and member microdata available for free/open download. Chronicle must capture the exact licence text before a native-ILCS release; v1 itself republishes no ILCS unit record. The populace-US donor artifact's own public licence and exact certified revision must also be pinned before execution.

notes: The target dataset year is 2024. source_coverage.json follows the country-neutral populace#265 contract. validation_bands.json reports ArmStat national-accounts comparisons plus harvested CEQ/World Bank oracle bands; the latter are never gates unless promoted through Ledger. latest.json uploads last as the atomic pointer. No release or publication machinery exists in this spec-only package.
